entries.subject: SDSS DR9 color HiPS
entries.finding: A 1125 x 1125 px hips2fits cutout of CDS/P/SDSS9/color, 7.5 arcmin wide at the HiPS's 0.40 arcsec per pixel. All 17 Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 19 in it have a star within 4 px of their requested places. Shallow: the outer envelope fades into the sky noise.

entries.subject: Observatory press images of NGC 4424
entries.finding: ESA/Hubble potw1713a covers 2.70 x 2.67 arcmin and potw1508a 1.57 x 1.54 arcmin of a galaxy whose RC3 isophotal diameter is 3.6 arcmin: both cut its ends. The ESO and NOIRLab image archives return nothing for NGC 4424.
entries.revisitWhen: A whole-disc photograph is published under an attribution licence.

entries.subject: DESI Legacy Surveys DR10 color HiPS
entries.finding: Deeper than SDSS and shows more of the outer envelope; it draws saturated stars with ringed cores. Not used: the three SH0ES hosts in the SDSS footprint were prepared from one survey, and the other two fields are damaged in this one.
entries.revisitWhen: A deeper image of this galaxy is wanted.

entries.subject: Disc tilt, position angle and near side
entries.finding: Leroy et al. (2021) give inclination 58.2 +/- 6.0 deg and position angle 88.3 +/- 2.0 deg. Lang et al. (2020) have no row for NGC 4424, and the galaxy shows no spiral arms, so neither the receding side nor the rotation sense is known: the near side drawn is one of two.
entries.revisitWhen: A velocity field with its receding side, or a published near side, is found.

entries.subject: Catalogues of NGC 4424's nebulae and clusters
entries.finding: The PHANGS-MUSE nebular catalogue (Groves et al. 2023, J/MNRAS/520/4902/catalog) has no rows for NGC 4424. No other catalogue of its nebulae or clusters was searched for in this change, so the bank has no dots.
entries.revisitWhen: CDS is searched for its HII regions, clusters or remnants with sky positions.
